title: Boone County Planning Commission — October 7, 2026 minutes index recheck
authorityBoundary: The official Planning Commission index was rechecked and remains byte-for-byte identical to the archived snapshot. It still does not link October 7 Business Meeting or Public Hearing minutes. This establishes current index-link status only; it does not establish that minutes do not exist elsewhere, that no action occurred at the meetings, or that the 2026 zoning rewrite was or was not adopted.
adoptedSignAuthority: Continue using the separately archived adopted Boone County Zoning Regulations Article 34 as sign-regulation authority unless reviewed official action records establish final adoption and effectiveness of replacement text.
